title: Climbing Dome and Rest Zone
description: Original playground climbing-area scene: one complete triangulated climbing dome occupies the large left bay, a complete backless bench sits beside it across an open side strip, and an intact concave soft-mat corner marks the separate front-right entry edge. The original whole dome retains every rod, joint and triangular window; the bench and mat remain complete and unit scale. This is not the older seesaw/slide corner nor the sand/crawl/rider area: its spatial organization is one dominant climbing enclosure and a separate rest edge, not a row of low play stations. Three complete old models, one scene-only base, one scene preset and zero new independent models. Static illustrative park layout only, no age suitability, fall-zone, impact attenuation, access-code compliance or playground safety certification. Complete original mesh hierarchy, oriented triangles and solid PBR are preserved. One scene preset and zero new independent reusable models.
